layouts.name: Balocco Alfa Romeo
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The manufacturer identifies the 5.6 km Alfa Romeo course at Balocco in its 2019 release. The independently mapped full Northern sweep, two straight chicanes, Eastern technical return, underpass and complete Southern terminal hairpin identify this configuration. The Southern return follows the continuous outside curve rather than the two nearby angular training connections. The selected public OSM centerline is 5590 m against the 5591 m catalogue distance; neither the high-speed oval nor Langhe loop is substituted. All vertices remain exact pinned OSM nodes; course direction and historical corner alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5590.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
